idea-plugin.name: MoonlightCode Agentic Support
idea-plugin.description:
The plan gate and held approvals, answered from the IDE. When a governed Claude Code session proposes a plan, it opens as a review tab in the window that owns the session: the plan in sections, a comment box per section, and four verdicts — Approve, Open question, Refine, No-go — sent back to the agent with your comments anchored to the sections they are about.

A danger-zone action held by a frozen phase is answered from a notification with Allow or Refuse; refusing asks why, because the agent is told and acts on it.

action.description: Open the plan review, or allow/refuse the held action, for the selected or blocked session
Pick any outstanding hold and answer it
Open the plan the active session last proposed
